track.title: Tweaks
track.scope: Small improvements and polish; no new features.

items.title: Banner: A.N.D.R.E. boxed title + backronym tagline
items.problem: The title-screen banner still renders the old project name 'AWESOME STOW' (11 boxed letters in andre/src/ui/banner.rs) and the generic tagline 'The ultimate dotfiles manager'.
items.done_when: Banner renders A.N.D.R.E. and the backronym tagline on wide and narrow terminals; cargo test + clippy clean.
items.verification: Run andre; the banner shows 5 rainbow boxed letters A.N.D.R.E. (each '║ A. ║') and the tagline 'Another Neat Dotfile Repository Engine'.
items.evidence: andre/src/ui/banner.rs:21 const LETTERS = ['A','N','D','R','E']; line 23 const TAGLINE = 'Another Neat Dotfile Repository Engine'. Cargo test -p andre --test render banner: test_banner_has_content passed (1/1, 0.01s). CHANGELOG 'Changed' entry for 42cd9a6 documents the rename. Code landed in 07fa302 (rsync from Codeberg where the rename had already been applied); the plan item was simply never closed out.

items.title: Main Menu number keys 1-7
items.problem: MainMenuComponent labels show 1-7 but only Enter activates; digit keys should select the Nth item.
items.done_when: Keys 1-7 dispatch the same transitions as Enter on that index; footer MainMenu hints mention digits.
steps: Handle KeyCode::Char('1'..='7') in menu.rs; add interaction tests; update footer MainMenu hint line if present.
